title: Hello world greeting
description:
Render an `

` element containing the text `Hello, World!`. The seeded `App.jsx` component is the entry point — replace its body so the rendered output matches the expected text exactly (case sensitive, including the comma and exclamation mark). ## Expected output ```jsx

Hello, World!

``` The `main.jsx` entry file already mounts `` into `#root` — you only need to edit `App.jsx`. SolidJS components are plain functions that return JSX; no signals or effects are required for this challenge.
